episodes.title: Over 100 Renounce Cultism in Edo
episodes.description:
Over 100 individuals have renounced cultism in Edo State, marking a significant step in the fight against cult-related violence and insecurity. What does this development mean for the state’s efforts to restore peace, rehabilitate former cultists and discourage young people from joining secret cult groups?

Watch the full report for details.
